reason: The README describes a plugin that centrally routes all in-process subagent model requests through a configured LLM provider, model, and reasoning-effort setting.

summaries.zh: 统一覆盖进程内子代理的模型请求，将其路由到配置的 LLM 提供商、模型和推理强度。
summaries.en: Uniformly overrides in-process subagent model requests to use a configured LLM provider, model, and reasoning effort.
